description: The workspace’s receiving host on eusend.app. Mail to any address at it arrives as an email.received webhook and in list_inbound_emails. status is active, paid_plan_required when the plan does not include receiving, on_hold while the account is under review, or disabled when an administrator disabled receiving. Held or disabled receiving defers new mail.
